description:
The chunk header reserves a flags byte ("1 byte: Flags (reserved)"). decode_header/1 already parses it into the header map and no caller reads it, so populating it is backward compatible with every existing reader.

Use it as a consolidation level: 0 for a chunk written by the demux, N+1 for a pack built from level-N inputs.

The planner merges only runs of equal level. That seals an emitted pack against being merged again with newer neighbours, which is what keeps a hot shard's trailing pack from being rewritten on every pass — the objects a live puller is most likely to be reading. It also leaves room for later leveling without a second format change.
title: Chunk header flags byte carries a consolidation level
